scope: Six medium eggs at the Fineli 8513 edible portion of 55 g each give a 330 g reference batch. Use all six eggs for twelve filled halves. Use commercial full-fat mayonnaise and prepared mustard rather than brand-specific products whose fibre or polyol values are unavailable. The seasoning uses fresh chives. No physical preparation trial was performed.
